تقتصرون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِرُونَ (taqtaṣirūna) /taq.ta.sˤi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# تُقْتَصَرُونَ (tuqtaṣarūna) /tuq.ta.sˤa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
